svg.text: orange rule = 320 mm bed and footprint · green = the nested cascade cones · stages = cascade height / 10 mm, and no amount of nesting buys more — the tower for comparison is 63 stages / 857 drops in air
sphere under a fluted crown, on a short foot
oblate test, flattened poles - widest for its height
nut with a cupule cap - the cap lifts off to prune
elongated follicle cone - keeps almost all the drop count
inverted cone, flat perforated face - you look down into it
squat cup with a heavy rim - lowest and widest
bi-pointed ovoid of overlapping scales - ports become scales
inflated pod with radiating horns - horns are the return tubes
split along three seams - the split IS the viewing port
sphere with a face cut away, terraced shells stepping inward
